title: Taxy: taxonomy assignment of ASVs
description: Taxy is a Perl tool for the taxonomy assignment of amplicon sequence variants (ASVs), for example from eDNA metabarcoding studies. ASVs are searched with BLAST against a local NCBI nucleotide (nt) database and the hits are assigned taxonomy using a local taxonomy database. Searches run in parallel and Taxy is also available as a Docker image (ghcr.io/ndierckx/taxy).
